decisions.reason: Piqué upholstery fabric builds directly on the firm's existing weaving knowledge, allowing it to interpret and learn from early results, so the probability of dropping is low.
Semi-transparent bouclé-effect decorative fabric requires less familiar yarn and lightweight fabric knowledge, limiting the firm's ability to assimilate feedback, so it is likely dropped.
The flame-retardant dotted jacquard curtain fabric leverages existing jacquard weaving and can be improved through in-house finishing or research cooperation, so it is likely kept.
Double-face wool-blend decoration fabric is a more specialized weave but still related to the firm's core textile capabilities, so moderate drop probability and likely kept.
Semi-transparent wool bouclé leno fabric combines specialized leno weaving with unfamiliar bouclé effects, far from existing knowledge, so it is dropped.
